interpretations: For each moon phase, including a separate group for missing phases, use only observatory stations matched to at least one telescope. Return the phase, the unrounded average of each station’s nonmissing telescope bandwidth usage average, the number of distinct matched stations in the phase, and that count divided by the total number of distinct matched stations across all phases
Include observatory stations with no matching telescope in the phase counts and denominator; their missing bandwidth averages do not contribute to the phase average
queries:
WITH station_usage AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
  FROM observatories AS o
  JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage AS phase,
  AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
  COUNT(*) AS station_count,
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station_usage) AS station_fraction
FROM station_usage
GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH station_bandwidth AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  COUNT(*) AS phase_count,
  SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS denominator,
  AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS phase_avg_bandusagepct
FROM station_bandwidth
GROUP BY lunarstage
